# gyro_storage_bucket (Resource)

An S3 bucket on a Gyro object storage service. Destroy deletes the bucket (it must be empty).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_storage_bucket" "assets" {
  service_id = 456
  name       = "assets"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `service_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `path_url` (String)
- `vhost_url` (String)
